title: Page
description: Adds a page of the landing in English and Spanish: src/pages/en/<path>.astro and src/pages/es/<path>.astro render its view (src/views/<id>/), which starts with a page hero and ends with a quiet call to action. Registers its title for the breadcrumb (src/data/pages.ts) and, with --nav, an entry in the header menu or a footer column (src/data/nav.ts). Add more sections with `add section --page <id>`.

id.description: Folder of its view and key of its copy (defaults to the path's segments joined with -)

titleEn.description: The page's name in English: menu, breadcrumb, browser title and its h1

headlineEn.description: The h1 of its hero in English, when it should say more than the title

descriptionEn.description: Meta description and hero deck, in English (search results show it)

descriptionEs.description: Meta description and hero deck, in Spanish

nav.description: Where it is linked: none, header (the main menu) or footer:<column id> (e.g. footer:company)

navBefore.description: With --nav, the id of the entry the page goes before (e.g. contact); without it, it goes last

examples.descriptionEn: Plans for every size of team.
